instruction: Candid lifestyle close-up photograph from an overhead angle of a cozy indoor living room. On a gray fabric couch, the bearded man with glasses (R2) in a pink t-shirt lies on the left, smiling down at the woman in the white t-shirt (R1) who lies on the right. The woman (R1) looks up at the man (R2) with a soft, loving smile, her left hand gently resting on his neck, while his hand rests on his wavy hair. Soft, diffused natural light illuminates their faces, creating a warm, intimate atmosphere with muted colors.
elements: R1 gently rests her left hand on R2's neck
R2 rests his hand on his own wavy hair while R1 touches his neck
R2 smiles down at R1 while R1 looks up at R2
